title: Juice N Power Vimtonic Nic Salt E-Liquid 5mg
description: Vimtonic from Juice N Power is a deliciously nostalgic blast of classic Vimto flavour, bursting with sweet, complex fruit flavours that will leave your tastebuds tingling. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
